facts.fact: The electronic medical record platform being brought into service at the El Bouni public primary-care facility in Annaba, planned for 15 November 2026, includes AI functions to assist clinicians in analysing data, per Algerie Confluences.
facts.system: dossier medical electronique (DME), EPSP El Bouni

DZA.note: No AI built or hosted in the country stated.

facts.fact: A training day was held for medical, paramedical and administrative staff of the El Bouni primary-care facility in Annaba ahead of the electronic medical record going live on 15 November 2026, with training running to 13 November.
